MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Both heat shrink assortments fit my electronics work because they would help insulate connections made with my battery holder, jumper wires, boards and relay.",
    "The range of tubing sizes makes sense for working with different wires; I selected the Ginsco kit, while the Eventronic kit would serve the same need as an alternative."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Buying circuit assembly supplies does not mean I own a 3D printer or need PLA, PETG or ABS filament.",
    "The feeler gauge and large caliper require a measurement task I have not identified, and my caster purchase does not establish that the threaded inserts would fit anything I am building.",
    "A twelve-pack of super glue exceeds any repair need I currently have."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in hands-on electronics seems to have been extended too broadly to fabrication and 3D printing supplies.",
    "My caster purchase seems to have been treated as a reason to suggest other mechanical supplies without knowing the dimensions or purpose of my project."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The useful connection across my battery holder, boards, wires and relay is assembling electrical circuits, where insulating connections is a concrete next step.",
    "I choose supplies when they address a specific need; general usefulness alone is not enough for me to buy a tool or material.",
    "The two tubing kits meet the same immediate need, so liking both does not mean I would buy both."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions partly recognized my electronics work but stretched that interest into printing and mechanical projects I have not shown a need for."
}
